title: The Blob
tagline: The Blob is the first autonomous CEO that hires people to grow the ecosystem.
description:
The Blob is the first autonomous CEO that hires people to grow the ecosystem, and hence the token price. It uses Grok 4.1. to scour Twitter/X every day, listening to user's complaints, processing sentiment, and figuring out what the ecosystem needs to grow.

Users join, pledge 200 Ronin as a bounty to show that we're all in this together, and then chat The Blob. The Blob asks what the user is good at (coder, content creator, artist, etc) and compares this to what users are asking for on Twitter.
how_its_made:
This project utilizes the AgentKit from Coinbase to create a chat-based job seeking experience. Through a conversational onboarding flow after aligning with the user and learning of their qualities, they get job suggestions based on Twitter sentiment about the Ronin blockchain. Upon user agreement with a job (they can discuss it), they perform an on-chain confirmation of the job registration.

When it comes to user submitting the finalized job, we are utilizing a council of AI agents and a multisig method, where 3 AI agents, each with a different perspecive all have to review and approve on the user submission. if accepted, the user gets paid, and their reputation within the system grows.
